verdict: No paid activity this period; Google Business engagement dropped sharply.
narrative: In the last 28 days, there was no paid advertising spend on Meta or Google Ads, so your Google Business Profile was the sole source of new engagement. Organic search clicks are actually up 10% over the same comparison window, which points to a local map-pack visibility issue rather than a drop in overall demand for your services. We're reviewing your Google Business Profile to address the visibility decline and determine next steps for reactivating paid lead generation.
